title: Fellowship of the Ring Theatrical vs Extended for first time viewer

commenti.body: I think the Theatrical is just fine. It's a solid movie, not too long, with everything you need to fall in love with the series. Some people don't have the attention span for the extended cut, especially if they're not sure if they'll like LOTR, so I'd do the Theatrical.

Few years ago I watched trilogy with my younger brother and it was his first time. We started with The Fellowship of the Ring (EE) and I noticed he was bored for the most part of the first hour or so until he was hooked. And my brother isn't big fan of the fantasy genre. So I assume your friend will be fine with EE.
